title: Tasks
motion: Clipboard rises; boxes and lines draw individually; one check completes.
uses: Project task list / board: no tasks

title: Projects
motion: Folder settles; a document rises behind the front; document details draw.
uses: Projects: first use and no active projects

title: Accounts
motion: A company and smaller overlapping house pop into place; three standard user badges appear to the right, with two overlapping and one separate.
uses: Accounts: companies, families, people and vendors

title: People
motion: Profile cards enter; portrait resolves; contact details draw.
uses: No people linked to a pipeline card

title: Team members
motion: Three members arrive, then their circles drift gently at staggered phases for two slow cycles and settle.

title: Pipeline
motion: Board appears, lane headings draw, then example card silhouettes settle into place.
uses: Entire pipeline with no cards; individual lanes retain text drop targets

title: Time tracking
motion: Clock face settles; markers draw; hands sweep once into position.
uses: Time tracking: no entries for day

title: Expenses
motion: Receipt rises, each expense row writes on, then the total and currency detail resolve.

title: Bookings
motion: Calendar rises; day cells appear in sequence; selected day receives a small check.
uses: Bookings: first use and selected type with no bookings

title: Schedule
motion: Calendar rises; shift blocks build across the week.

title: Booking types
motion: A calendar establishes the context; details draw and a configuration gear turns into place.

title: Forms
motion: Form sheet rises; heading, input field, and choices draw individually.

title: Form submissions
motion: Response paper rises; form detail writes in; a small paper plane arrives and rests.
uses: Activity: no forms waiting for review

title: Form builder
motion: A form canvas settles, then sections and field blocks assemble from top to bottom.
uses: Form builder: no sections or fields

title: Accounting ledger
motion: Open ledger settles; matching entry lines write across both pages.

title: Bank transactions
motion: Bank silhouette assembles; an import arrow draws once into its resting position.

title: Inbox
motion: The box outline draws first; three papers drop into the tray one by one and their details draw on.

title: All caught up
motion: Work cards settle; a completion badge appears and its check draws once.

title: Activity history
motion: Timeline draws downward; event nodes and their cards enter in order.

title: Reports
motion: Report panel settles; axes draw; bars build in staggered order.
uses: Scheduled vs actual report: no visits

title: Files & attachments
motion: Document sheets settle; details write on and the paperclip draws around the attachment.

title: Saved links
motion: Two link halves slide gently into their connected resting position.

title: Notes
motion: Notebook rises; note lines draw one by one; pencil settles beside it.
uses: Task description if a larger prompt is appropriate

title: Comments
motion: Comment bubble arrives; its three dots appear once in a short sequence and stay still.

title: Conversations
motion: Opening message bubble arrives; a reply follows; message lines reveal in reading order.

title: No matches
motion: Magnifying glass makes one short search movement and settles; a neutral dash indicates no matches.
uses: Filtered accounts, people, projects, invoices, forms and tasks

title: Configuration
motion: Configuration sliders draw; controls appear; the gear makes one short settling turn.

title: API keys
motion: A credential card settles; a simple key turns into place without displaying secret data.

title: Notifications
motion: Bell makes one gentle pivot and settles; a single light accent completes.

title: Line items
motion: Register panel appears; line-item bullets, descriptions, and amounts draw in sequence.
uses: No uninvoiced time or reimbursable expenses in a selected period
